name: Intra-method NPE via guard removal or drift
description: Inside a single method, an object or field is initially checked for null before use. The bug removes, relaxes, or drifts the guard so that the dereference can now be executed with a null value under realistic conditions. This commonly happens when a null-check is moved away from the dereference, a new branch bypasses the guard, or a refactor leaves the dereference outside the guarded region.

trigger_conditions.test_shape: Tests that call the method with inputs that sometimes lead to a null reference but previously avoided NPE thanks to the guard.
trigger_conditions.input_properties: At least one scenario where the new branch or missing guard path is taken and the reference is null at the point of dereference.

example.description: A single method originally guards a nullable header before trimming/normalizing it. A later branch introduces guard drift by overwriting the guarded reference with an optional query parameter without re-checking, so the final normalization dereferences null on realistic inputs where the query param is absent.
